messages:
Alex H: Quick Q on API rate-limits — I need to confirm what a 429 looks like for our public /v1/generate route. Do we return Retry-After? Do we include X-RateLimit-* headers on error and success? Also: is burst allowed per-route or only global? Trying to write SDK retry logic.

Maria G: Short answer: 429 includes Retry-After (seconds) + X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset (unix epoch secs). We add the headers on 2xx and 429/5xx where relevant.

Alex H: Nice. Is Reset an absolute epoch or relative seconds? SDK needs number to schedule requests.

Maria G: Reset is absolute unix epoch seconds (UTC). Retry-After is strictly seconds to wait. We added both because clients prefer one or the other.

Jay K: For burst: we use a token-bucket per route with a small shared global bucket. Routes have their own steady-state rate and a burst capacity up to 3x tokens but only for short windows (~10s). If global capacity is low you'll get 429 even if per-route has tokens.

Nina P: To add: Dedicated customers can configure higher per-route burst in Dedicated tier, but public hosted defaults are conservative.

Alex H: That helps. On 429 body: do we include a machine-readable error code so SDK can switch behavior (eg 'rate_limit_per_route' vs 'rate_limit_global')?

Maria G: Yes — body JSON: { "error": { "type": "rate_limit", "code": "route_limit_exceeded", "message": "Rate limit exceeded" } } — schema stable. SDK should inspect error.code.

Robin: Docs owner here — please file a PR to docs repo with: exact headers table + example curl + recommended retry/backoff snippet. I'll review.

Alex H: I'll open a tiny PR. Suggested backoff: exponential jitter: base=0.5s, factor=2, max=60s. For Retry-After use that value + small jitter.

Maria G: Also callouts: we return X-RateLimit-Remaining on streamed responses but it's updated per chunk — stream clients should check final header.

ratebot: deploy notice: rate-limit config change rolled out to us-east-1 at 1749001200 — bump in burst window to 3x for /v1/embedding-testing.

Jay K: FYI: I'll add a config flag so SDK devs can opt into 'respect-retry-after' strict mode.

Alex H: Thanks all — action items: Alex open PR for docs + code snippet, Jay add SDK flag issue, Robin review docs. Ping me when PRs exist. :thumbsup:
